item.title: LogicGrid 11.3.0
item.description:
New

  • Grid Feel: triplets and swing. The grid can now show triplet 8ths, triplet 16ths, swung 8ths, and swung 16ths. Press Control Option T in Logic to open the Grid Feel palette, pick a feel, and drag the swing number while you watch the grid move. Swing follows Logic's own convention: 50 is straight, 66 is the classic triplet feel. Bars and beats stay locked to what Logic draws, and if you zoom past where the feel can draw accurately the grid steps aside and tells you which way to zoom.
  • Customizable keyboard shortcuts. Every shortcut can now be set to whatever combo you like. Open the menu bar icon, go to Keyboard Shortcuts, and choose Customize Shortcuts. Record a new combo for any action, and reset one or all of them back to the defaults any time.
